title: Lowpoly End To End Commands Io And Mutations
description: Get the 💠️lowpoly plugin working end to end: a full blown, exhaustive command surface for lowpoly editing with proper IO (import/export round-trips), mutations (schema mutations wired to engine ops), and a booting, verifiable editor. Audit the current taxonomy tree (🗿️artifacts/💠️lowpoly/🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any/{🧬️schema,🚪️io,⚙️engine,✏️editor,👁️viewer}), find every gap (empty command groups, stub 🟦️component.ts files, missing mutations, missing IO formats, missing tests), close them, and verify with cargo check/clippy/test native + wasm32-wasip2 plus a real dev boot smoke test.
